guide.athanor.page1:
The Emerald Tablet

As above, so below.

This book records the art: aspects, rituals, the Great Work, and the rules of the world itself.
guide.athanor.page2:
I. Aspects

All things are made of eight basic aspects. The Resolver breaks items into aspect crystals; two crystals combine into a compound aspect at a crafting table.

Use a wand or lens on a block to read its aspects.
guide.athanor.page3:
II. The Athanor

A 3x3x3 structure: Athanor Bricks, the core in front, a magma block under the back, an air chamber in the middle and Alchemical Glass on top.

Feed it crystals and a catalyst to recombine aspects into items.
guide.athanor.page4:
III. The Three Principles

Salt, Sulphur and Mercury. Set an Alembic over heat: cinnabar gives quicksilver and sulfur, gunpowder gives sulfur and salt, kelp and bone give salt, apples and wheat give Aqua Vitae.
guide.athanor.page5:
IV. Veins

Cinnabar, silver and lead ores now lie underground, and rock salt near the surface. Silver and lead smelt into ingots.

The Philosopher's Stone raises lead ore to silver, and silver ore to gold.
guide.athanor.page6:
V. Aether and Miasma

Every chunk holds aether. Rituals and some tools spend it and it slowly returns. A few chunks are ley nodes, far richer than the rest.

Resolving, recombining and rituals leave miasma, which slowly fades.
guide.athanor.page7:
VI. Miasma

At 40 it weakens you; at 100 it brings hunger and slowness and withers the grass; at 200 it withers you.

Scatter salt or place salt lamps to cleanse it. The Panacea grants a while of immunity.
guide.athanor.page8:
VII. The Heavens

Some rituals can only start by day or by night. Under a full moon every ritual runs at double speed.

The Alchemist's Lens shows the sky.
guide.athanor.page9:
VIII. Infusion

Up to eight Arcane Pedestals around a Ritual Altar. Place the items, then use the wand on the altar. Starting spends the chunk's aether; removing any item ruins the rite.
guide.athanor.page10:
IX. The Great Work

Salt, sulfur, quicksilver and perditio make Prima Materia. In the Hermetic Vessel:
Nigredo: heat below
Albedo: open sky at night
Citrinitas: open sky by day
Rubedo: heat and open sky, 30 aether
guide.athanor.page11:
X. Fruits of the Work

Rubedo becomes the Elixir of Life, or, by day on a ley node, the grand rite yields two Philosopher's Stones.

Albedo makes the Panacea; Citrinitas the Ouroboros Ring.
guide.athanor.page12:
XI. Instruments

Alkahest: dissolve blocks into aspects.
Quicksilver Mirror: return to a bound place.
Ouroboros Ring: mend with experience.
Arcanium tools: slowly mend with aether.
